visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The scene begins with a red divider opening to reveal the interior of a brightly lit bakery. Shelves filled with packaged breads and decorative boxes are visible under warm lighting. (2) A sequence of close-ups showcases various artisanal breads behind a glass display case, including large rustic loaves and braided pretzels. (3) A staff member wearing a white uniform, black cap, mask, and black gloves is seen reaching into the display case to retrieve bread items. (4) Multiple large bags of imported flour are shown stacked on the floor. The baker then uses a serrated knife to slice a large loaf of rustic bread on a dark counter. (5) Detailed close-ups show hands squeezing and tearing various breads, such as sourdough and purple-marbled toast, to demonstrate texture. (6) Mentaiko bread is topped with seaweed, and a milk cream roll is sliced to show a thick yellow filling. (7) A large Boston cream pie is taken out of a purple box and sliced, revealing a thick layer of white cream. (8) The camera pans through an indoor dining area on the second floor with tables and a view of a ferris wheel through large windows. (9) The final shot shows the exterior of the bakery, 'LA SFERA', with prominent red awnings and signage.

(6) [Subtitle]: 麵包都放在玻璃櫥窗裡展示. (7) [Subtitle]: 由店家拿取. (8) [Subtitle]: 用的是日本和法國進口麵粉. (9) [Subtitle]: 加上自家培養的魯邦酵母. (10) [Subtitle]: 口感自然有彈性. (11) [Subtitle]: 魯邦酸種是裸麥粉製作的純素麵包. (12) [Subtitle]: 外皮微脆. (13) [Subtitle]: 吃起來紮實帶自然酸香. (14) [Subtitle]: 芳野95是加了紫薯的雙色吐司. (15) [Subtitle]: 含水量很高口感超柔軟. (16) [Subtitle]: 有果乾和巧克力酸甜. (17) [Subtitle]: 明太子麵包會現場回烤. (18) [Subtitle]: 鋪滿日本明太子和魚卵. (19) [Subtitle]: 酥脆鹹香超涮嘴. (20) [Subtitle]: 冰涼的魯邦維也納. (21) [Subtitle]: 濕潤柔軟夾著奶油和糖粒. (22) [Subtitle]: 甜點超推波士頓派. (23) [Subtitle]: 蛋糕體蓬鬆帶點蜂蜜香. (24) [Subtitle]: 夾餡使用日本中澤鮮奶油. (25) [Subtitle]: 乳香濃郁不膩口. (26) [Subtitle]: 會員還能到二樓內用哦. (27) [Subtitle]: 你們快去買麵包. (28) [Subtitle]: 我們是虎麗笑嗨嗨. [Slogan]: 拉斯費拉 LA SFERA 麵包店 高雄市前鎮區中華五路939巷10號. (29) [Subtitle]: 下次再一起吃美食囉.

(2) As the baker appears, the narrator's tone remains friendly and professional. A faint high-frequency rustle of plastic gloves and display case movement is heard. (3) A soft, low-frequency squish and a crisp crackling sound are audible as the bread is squeezed, emphasizing its elasticity. The music volume remains steady. (4) A broadband tearing sound is clearly heard as rustic bread is pulled apart. The narrator's pitch rises to convey excitement about the texture. (5) The percussive 'thud' and 'clack' of a knife slicing through thick crust onto a wooden board create rhythmic accents. (6) A soft rustle of a cardboard box opening is heard, followed by a muffled, wet squish as a fork cuts through cream. (7) The narrator concludes with high speed and rising intonations. The BGM beat continues until a final hard cut.
